note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. `hasCriticalResult` (the follow-up critical-alert trigger) bundles a positive antibody screen together with true identity-safety events (ABO discrepancy, unmet two-sample rule) and an incompatible crossmatch — so an antibody-positive result, despite grading only 'moderate' severity, still escalates straight to critical-alert / urgent-review. The second persona below instead uses insufficient-units (the other moderate-severity path) specifically because it is the one NOT folded into `hasCriticalResult`, to demonstrate a genuine non-critical-alert 'recommended' outcome.

personas.name: normal-compatible-group-o-negative-complete
personas.description: A straightforward compatible crossmatch: group O RhD-negative, historical group concordant, antibody screen negative, two-sample rule met, exactly as many compatible units available as crossmatched, every mandatory report section present — expect normal classification + none severity + 100% completeness + routine follow-up + no-action.

state.clinicalHistory: Elective hip replacement; pre-operative group and crossmatch for 2 units.
state.findingsNarrative: Group and screen concordant with historical record; crossmatch compatible by electronic/serological method.
state.impression: Compatible for 2 units red cells; no antibodies detected.
state.recommendedFollowUp: Issue per standard pathway when clinically required.

expected.recommendedAction: Issue compatible units per the standard transfusion pathway; manage per usual care.

firedRules.description: Compatible result on a complete, concordant work-up with no critical result; classified as normal.
No abnormal finding; abnormality severity graded none.
No escalation rule fired; routine follow-up only.

personas.name: abnormal-insufficient-units-moderate-complete
personas.description: A compatible crossmatch with no antibodies and no identity-safety concerns, but only 2 of the 4 requested units are currently available: insufficient units is the one moderate-severity path that is NOT bundled into the critical-result predicate, so this stays at 'recommended' follow-up rather than escalating to critical-alert — expect abnormal classification + moderate severity + 100% completeness + recommended follow-up + further-testing.

state.clinicalHistory: Major gastrointestinal bleed; 4 units red cells crossmatched for a planned transfusion.
state.findingsNarrative: Group and screen concordant with historical record; crossmatch compatible, but only 2 of the 4 requested units are currently held in stock.
state.impression: Compatible for the 2 units available; 2 further units on order from the regional blood centre.
state.recommendedFollowUp: Order the 2 outstanding units urgently from the regional blood centre.

expected.recommendedAction: Select antigen-negative units and/or order additional compatible units as clinically indicated.

firedRules.description: An abnormal structured finding (e.g. insufficient compatible units) is present; classified as abnormal.
Fewer compatible units are available than were crossmatched; severity graded moderate.

flags.description: Fewer compatible units are available than were crossmatched.
flags.suggestedAction: Order additional compatible units to meet the requested quantity.

personas.name: critical-abo-discrepancy-identity-safety-incomplete
personas.description: A new sample groups as A-positive, but the historical record does not concordantly match it — a possible Wrong-Blood-in-Tube identity event per SHOT: this ABO discrepancy auto-escalates classification to critical and follow-up to critical-alert regardless of the other axes, independently of the crossmatch (withheld pending resolution) and the two-sample rule (met); the critical result has not yet been communicated, and several report sections are not yet completed while the discrepancy is investigated — expect critical classification + major severity + 40% completeness + critical-alert follow-up + urgent-review.

state.findingsNarrative: New sample groups as A RhD-positive, but the historical record on file shows group O RhD-negative — a discordant result requiring a fresh group-check sample before any issue.
state.clinicianNotes: Consultant haematologist informed; fresh sample requested to resolve the discrepancy before crossmatch proceeds.

expected.recommendedAction: Communicate the critical result directly to the requester now, withhold issue until resolved, and document the conversation.

firedRules.description: An ABO discrepancy (historical-group non-concordance) or an unmet two-sample group-check rule is present; classified as critical.
An ABO discrepancy or unmet two-sample rule is present; abnormality severity graded major.
Mandatory report section missing: clinical history.
Mandatory report section missing: antibody screen.

A critical result (incompatible crossmatch, clinically-significant antibodies, ABO discrepancy, or unmet two-sample rule) auto-escalates follow-up urgency to critical-alert regardless of the other axes.

flags.description: A critical result (incompatible crossmatch, clinically-significant antibodies, ABO discrepancy, or unmet two-sample rule) is present.
flags.suggestedAction: Communicate the critical result to the requester immediately, withhold issue until resolved, and document the communication.

flags.description: Critical result present but it has not been recorded as communicated.
flags.suggestedAction: Contact the requester now and record who was informed, with date and time.

flags.description: An ABO discrepancy (historical-group non-concordance) or an unmet two-sample group-check rule indicates a possible Wrong-Blood-in-Tube / identity event.
flags.suggestedAction: Do not issue. Investigate the discrepancy, request a fresh group-check sample, and escalate to the consultant haematologist.

flags.description: A crossmatch / compatibility test was not performed for a crossmatch or emergency-issue request.
flags.suggestedAction: Complete the appropriate compatibility testing or document the emergency-issue justification.

flags.description: No impression / conclusion has been recorded.
flags.suggestedAction: Add an impression that answers the compatibility question.
